description: cohesivity.ai offers free agent native backend services. Anonymous account (no-signup) to get started through MCP or API. Hosting, postgres, email, storage, containers, LLMs, voice and third-party APIs. Includes free tiers and 5 USD/mo in AI and Search credits. Top-ups through x402.

commands: claude mcp add --transport http --scope user cohesivity https://cohesivity.ai/mcp/manage

notes: The hosted management MCP uses OAuth 2.1 authorization code flow with mandatory PKCE S256 and dynamic client registration.
The bundled local project-bootstrap stdio server needs no Cohesivity account or authentication.
On 2026-08-23, the live endpoint returned the expected OAuth protected-resource challenge, and its public server card confirmed the Streamable HTTP transport and endpoint.
The official implementation declares 68 typed management tools; tools/list requires an authorized Cohesivity account.
